elements.label: Figure 7.15
elements.title: Image of a Musician Created by OpenArt.
elements.details: Photorealistic image of a woman playing an upright bass. The image resembles a real photo but contains numerous details that do not make sense, typical of AI-generated images. The woman is wearing a blue dress, standing in front of a microphone and music stand with sheet music visible. The image was generated using OpenArt from the prompt 'A woman playing upright bass.'
elements.summary: This AI-generated image illustrates common problems with detail in AI-created material, such as inconsistencies and errors despite photorealistic appearance, highlighting challenges in AI image generation.
